LanguageData.SSC_CosmeticRitualPrecept.label: reshaping ritual
LanguageData.SSC_CosmeticRitualPrecept.description: Use the tissue-reshaping properties of regular PNA through traditional ceremony. Only a Master-Slave Order ideoligion can perform it. The adult practitioner (Medical 6+) and recipient must share that ideoligion; the recipient may be a colonist or colony slave. No research required. The practitioner fetches 20 regular PNA and 2 herbal medicine from accessible, allowed supplies; no pre-hauling to the ritual site is needed. One ground stack of each material must cover the shortfall in the practitioner's inventory. Supplies are consumed together after arrival, before the two-hour formal ceremony. Cancelling preparation drops unused supplies; consumed materials are not refunded. Success raises vanilla Beauty one step, up to +2. Success/failure causes reaction severity 0.15/0.60, fading 0.10 per day; recovery blocks further reshaping. Base quality is 40%: Medical 6 with no other modifiers gives about 61.5% success; full quality gives 80%. Vanilla repeat, expectations and progress modifiers apply.
